premises.text: Mesh networking app shares mobile internet across phone, tablet, and laptop by crowdsourcing connectivity
premises.evidence_span: OpenGarden is a mesh networking application that enables you to share your mobile internet among your phone, tablet, and laptop

premises.text: Installing yields faster and more reliable mobile internet for participants
premises.evidence_span: you also benefit from a faster mobile internet and more reliable mobile internet

premises.text: Network effects improve connectivity as more people join across platforms (Android, Mac, Windows)
premises.evidence_span: the more people on the OpenGallery network, the better connectivity we can all achieve together

value.text: Share and improve mobile internet connectivity across nearby devices and users
value.evidence_span: share your mobile internet among your phone, tablet, and laptop

notes: Thin on commercial model; fundraising story and install counts excluded as financing/traction. User anecdotes treated as illustration of P2, not separate premises. Hiring call excluded. Single domain justified: product is one connectivity mechanism. ASR OpenGarden/OpenGallery.
